commands.name: test
commands.description: Run the Go tests (under -race) for the named package paths, in whichever module holds each one, e.g. ./host or ./ext/files/... Pass package paths only.

commands.name: test_all
commands.description: Run every module's tests under -race, as CI does. Slow (a few minutes): use it to confirm a finished change, and run_test while iterating.

commands.name: vet
commands.description: go vet every module and example.
